parsed.post: Discarding MATRIX_LR=0.03 (1.007861) as it was significantly worse than my previous best (1.000836). The higher learning rate seems to have destabilized the DEPTH=6 model in this 5-minute window. Reverting to 0.03 and will instead try a more cautious increase to 0.035 or adjust weight decay.
parsed.description: Slightly increasing learning rate to 0.035 and introducing a small amount of weight decay (0.01) to see if regularization helps stabilize the capacity gains at depth 6.
